global_reciters.name: Noreen Muhammad Siddiq
global_reciters.bio: Born in Al-Farajab, North Kordofan, Sudan in 1982. Served as the chief imam of the Grand Mosque of Khartoum and Al-Sayyida Sanhouri Mosque. Celebrated worldwide for his soulful, traditional African pentatonic chanting in the recitation of Al-Duri 'an Abi 'Amr until his passing in 2020.

global_reciters.name: Ahmad Al-Hudhaify
global_reciters.bio: Born in Medina, Saudi Arabia, son of Chief Imam Sheikh Ali Al-Hudhaify. Serves as Imam and Khateeb of Quba Mosque and has been appointed to lead prayers at the Prophet's Mosque in Medina. Recites with a disciplined, calming cadence strongly echoing the classic Medinan style.

global_reciters.name: Khalid Al-Muhanna
global_reciters.bio: Born in Al-Ahsa, Saudi Arabia and earned a doctorate from the College of Hadith. Appointed as an Imam of the Prophet's Mosque in Medina in 2019. Known for his clear articulation, soothing acoustic tone, and adherence to strict classical tajweed.

global_reciters.name: Muhammad Barhaji
global_reciters.bio: Prominent Quran reciter based in Medina, Saudi Arabia. Regularly leads prayers in Medina and participates in Quranic teaching circles. Characterized by a warm, contemplative recitation following the Hafs 'an 'Asim riwayah.

global_reciters.name: Abdullah Al-Qarafi
global_reciters.bio: Imam and reciter in Medina, Saudi Arabia. Known for leading Taraweeh and Tahajjud prayers in mosques across the holy city of Medina. Recites with a gentle, humble rhythm deeply rooted in the Medinan tradition.

global_reciters.name: Abu Bakr Ash-Shatri
global_reciters.bio: Born in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia in 1970 and received ijazah in Quran recitation under Sheikh Ayman Suwayd. Has led prayers in major mosques across Jeddah, Riyadh, Dubai, and Bahrain. Celebrated across the Muslim world for his warm, smooth, and easily followed murattal style.

global_reciters.name: Hani Ar-Rifai
global_reciters.bio: Born in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia in 1974. Memorized the Quran by age twelve and studied under prominent scholars. Served as the Imam of the Al-Anani Mosque in Jeddah and personal reciter in the Royal Court. Celebrated for his deeply moving, heartfelt recitations that resonate with millions of listeners worldwide.

global_reciters.name: Wadee Hammadi Al-Yamani
global_reciters.bio: Born in Aden, Yemen and obtained a bachelor's degree in Islamic studies from the University of Science and Technology in Sana'a. Has led Taraweeh and Qiyam prayers at prominent mosques in Kuwait and Dubai. Known for his soothing, calm melodic style and clear tajweed.
